summary: Q1 2026 reported May 19. Revenue $99M, +30% YoY. Key catalysts: (1) Mercedes-Benz L3 strategic supplier (Europe + China, Thailand manufacturing); (2) ETX lidar product launch; (3) Picasso 6D SPAD-SoC and Kosmo spatial intelligence device — move into software/data with higher margins; (4) Backlog exceeds 6 million units; (5) Hong Kong listing plans. Next earnings likely Q2 around August 2026.
